title: Contents Packout & Storage Closing Payment
content:
**Scope.** This Contents Packout & Storage policy fixes the amount of the customer's own closing payment on an insurance-funded Partial Contents Packout, Full Contents Packout, High-Value Contents Packout or Commercial Contents and Records Recovery job in returned or invoiced status whose linked claim file is on an arrangement other than Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support, and only that payment, while no storage line billed to customer on the job has stayed unpaid longer than the tier's referral days counted from the first day of its period, customer payments settling the oldest storage and declared-value coverage lines billed to customer first; an account past that point is referred under the base storage rule, a payment on a job the customer's-share rule governs follows that rule, and a payment on any other job is posted in full as tendered under the base payment rule.

The customer makes the closing payment personally through the company's secure payment channel, and staff never take card or bank details; a credit card payment carries the credit card surcharge percentage of the payment amount, booked with the payment as its own line under the base payment rule.

## When the closing payment is fixed

The closing payment is not figured until the job carries the pack-back box line owed for its return. The closing payment is not taken until the furniture reset line owed for the return stands on the job. The closing payment is fixed only after the truck loads that brought the contents home stand on the job as a move-back line.

## Applicability

| Job | Governed by this policy? |
|---|---|
| insurance-funded; Partial, Full or High-Value Contents Packout or Commercial Contents and Records Recovery; returned or invoiced; claim file not on Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support; no customer-billed storage line unpaid beyond the referral days | yes |
| customer-billed storage unpaid beyond the tier's referral days | no; referred under the base storage rule |
| a job the customer's-share rule governs | no; that rule applies |
| any other job | no; the payment is posted in full as tendered under the base payment rule |

## The payment: `pay_contents_closing_balance_f918d993`

**Capability.** The customer makes the closing payment on a contents job whose belongings are home, through the secure payment channel. The customer enters the customer's own card or bank details; the payment is posted in full to the one contents job named and lowers that job's balance due by the amount paid. When the customer pays by credit card, the credit card surcharge on the payment is booked on the same job as its own line at the same moment and raises the balance by that surcharge. The channel issues a confirmation number at the moment of payment, and the posted payment, any surcharge line and the new balance show on the job straight away.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `pay_contents_closing_balance_f918d993` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `contents_job_id` | the reference number of the contents job being paid, as given to the customer by the representative from the contents job record | identifier |
| `payment_method` | the tender used | `credit_card`, `debit_card` (drawn on the customer's bank account), `ach` (bank transfer from a checking or savings account) or `check` (paper or electronic check) |
| `amount` | the amount paid in USD | a positive figure rounded to 2 decimal places, half up |
| `surcharge_amount` | the credit card surcharge on this payment in USD | rounded to 2 decimal places, half up; 0.00 when `payment_method` is not `credit_card`, above zero only for a `credit_card` payment |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (posted), `contents_payment_id`, `payment_reference` (the confirmation number), `contents_job_id`, `payment_method`, `posted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `amount`, `surcharge_amount` (0.00 when none), `surcharge_charge_id` (empty when none) and `balance_due` (after the payment and any surcharge), amounts in USD to 2 decimal places.

**Errors.** "payment_method must be one of credit_card, debit_card, ach or check."; "amount must be a positive USD figure."; "surcharge_amount must be 0.00 unless payment_method is credit_card, and never negative."
